name: libdxfrw semantic oracle normalization
unknownEnvelopeFields: reject; declare a new projection before comparing it
nestedFields: preserve and compare every semantic field and its JSON type

numbers.equality: exact value and JSON numeric type; Boolean is not integer
numbers.nonfinite: reject; never replace with application strings
numbers.tolerance: none; derived geometry needs its own field-specific policy

provenance: record each toolVersion/provenance independently, not as semantic equality
strictJSON: reject duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, exponent overflow and non-JSON values
legacy: schema1 available only by explicit --comparison-schema 1; prior receipts unchanged
rule: Normalized hashes cannot replace scope, coverage, diagnostics or independent evidence. Any rule change increments schema.
